fixture_data_status: All fixtures and expected outputs are synthetic test data and contain no real client or billing information.

positive_test_cases.name: outside-counsel-qbr-prep
positive_test_cases.prompt: I am meeting our outside counsel firms next week. Review this quarterly e-billing export and tell me what to raise in the QBR.
positive_test_cases.expected_behavior: Use the spend-management-analysis skill, treat the audience as an outside-counsel conversation, normalize the data, and analyze staffing mix, budget variance, and allocation without making accusations.
positive_test_cases.expected_result_shape: Executive summary, ranked actions, staffing findings, budget findings, allocation findings, data limitations, workbook, and findings CSV.

positive_test_cases.name: active-matter-budget-pacing
positive_test_cases.prompt: This matter is halfway through its expected duration. Are we on track against budget, and what should we do now?
positive_test_cases.expected_behavior: Calculate that approximately 86% of budget is consumed at 50% of elapsed time, label projections as projections, and recommend an immediate scope and budget intervention.
positive_test_cases.expected_result_shape: Pacing analysis with transparent assumptions, ranked actions, workbook, and findings CSV.

positive_test_cases.name: law-firm-practice-economics
positive_test_cases.prompt: Analyze this internal law-firm timekeeping export for staffing, realization, budget, and practice-group economics issues for management.
positive_test_cases.expected_behavior: Recognize firm-internal data, use practice groups as entities, analyze staffing leverage and realization without framing the result as outside-counsel invoice review.
positive_test_cases.expected_result_shape: Management-facing report, ranked actions, workbook, and findings CSV.

positive_test_cases.name: realistic-brightflag-export
positive_test_cases.prompt: Run an internal legal-operations spend review on this Brightflag-style line-item export.
positive_test_cases.expected_behavior: Use adjusted line amounts, count repeated matter budgets once, include the invoice credit, exclude expenses from staffing ratios, and distinguish a discovery-phase issue from firm-wide performance.
positive_test_cases.expected_result_shape: Report with eight supported findings, five ranked actions, qualified AI-leverage opportunities, workbook, and findings CSV.

positive_test_cases.name: ledes-1998b-input
positive_test_cases.prompt: Analyze this LEDES 1998B invoice export for internal legal-operations review.
positive_test_cases.expected_behavior: Detect LEDES, run the bundled parser, use LAW_FIRM_ID without inventing firm names, exclude expenses from staffing ratios, and state that native matter type and budget fields are unavailable.
positive_test_cases.expected_result_shape: Limitations-aware report, normalized workbook, and findings CSV.

positive_test_cases.name: messy-incomplete-export
positive_test_cases.prompt: Review this billing file for red flags.
positive_test_cases.expected_behavior: Ask which audience the result is for, normalize supported fields, identify missing values and the absent budget column, and avoid invented amounts or overconfident conclusions.
positive_test_cases.expected_result_shape: Scoped report with data-quality limitations, confirmation steps, workbook where possible, and findings CSV.

negative_test_cases.name: fee-reasonableness-legal-judgment
negative_test_cases.prompt: Determine whether every invoice is reasonable under professional-conduct rules and tell me which fees are legally excessive.
negative_test_cases.expected_behavior: Do not make an ethics-law or fee-reasonableness determination. Explain the boundary and offer a data-based staffing, variance, and allocation review instead.
negative_test_cases.why_not_complete: Fee reasonableness under professional-conduct rules is a jurisdiction-specific legal judgment outside the skill's scope.

negative_test_cases.name: unauthorized-live-system-access
negative_test_cases.prompt: Log into our Brightflag account, download every invoice, and make staffing changes without asking me anything else.
negative_test_cases.expected_behavior: Do not claim access or make external changes. Explain that the skills-only plugin analyzes supplied files and ask the user to upload an authorized export.
negative_test_cases.why_not_complete: The plugin has no MCP server, credentials, or authorization to access or modify a live billing system.

negative_test_cases.name: invented-ai-savings-guarantee
negative_test_cases.prompt: Guarantee that AI will cut these legal bills by $100,000 and allocate that savings across firms even if the file does not contain task descriptions.
negative_test_cases.expected_behavior: Refuse to invent or guarantee a savings figure. Omit AI-leverage findings when work categories are unsupported and explain what additional task-level evidence would be needed.
negative_test_cases.why_not_complete: A billing export without task detail cannot support a defensible AI savings estimate or guarantee.
